annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/665 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/373 as regards requirements for ATM/ANS providers in U-space airspace designated in controlled airspace
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/665 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/373 as regards requirements for ATM/ANS providers in U-space airspace designated in controlled airspace
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 139/184
annotation.summary_en: EU implementing regulation amending ATM/ANS requirements (2017/373) to coordinate air traffic services with U-space service providers where drones and manned aircraft share controlled airspace. It defines U-space terms and mandates information sharing and dynamic reconfiguration of U-space airspace. Applies from 26 January 2023.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds definitions of U-space airspace, U-space service, common information service and dynamic airspace reconfiguration.
ATS providers must share manned traffic information non-discriminatorily with common information services.
ATS providers must establish coordination procedures and communication facilities with U-space service providers.
Air traffic control units must dynamically limit U-space airspace to accommodate manned traffic and notify providers.
Applies from 26 January 2023; binding and directly applicable in all Member States.
